title: P20: no per-field length caps on protocol primitives
description: protocol-06 §5.2 (IdentifierUri, opaque uri<V>) and §7.6 (UTF8String, opaque string<V>) set no maximum length. Readings: (a) invent per-field caps (MAX_URI_LEN etc., INVENTED NOT FROM SPEC); (b) no per-field cap in mimi-protocol, rely on RFC 9420 §2.1.2's 2^30-1 vector limit (enforced by tls_codec mls feature) plus a named total request-body cap in mimid-server. Chosen: (b). Rationale: one cap at the trust boundary bounds memory for every field; per-field caps would be invented limits that could reject spec-valid input from other implementations.
close_reason: Recorded during mimid-1wgh.5.1; reading chosen as described
